description: Use this when the user asks for their VAT return figures by box (VAT 201), what to enter in each box for a period, or a VAT return estimate from their records. The VAT return for the current or a chosen period laid out by VAT 201 box from the documents in Fatura Go: boxes 1a-1g by emirate, 3 and 10 (reverse charge), 4 (zero-rated), 5 (exempt), 9 (purchases with recoverable VAT), and totals 8, 11 and 14. It is an estimate until filed, not a filed return: always say so, and that the user checks it in EmaraTax. Boxes 2, 6 and 7 are not in Fatura Go. period: due (default, the return due next), open, or a key from periods. Needs access to VAT reports. Do not use it for what a box means in general (explain_vat_return_boxes).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

period.description: due (default), open, or a key from periods.
